articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: BitMEX faces Celsius lawsuit ahead of exchange closure
articles.description: The Celsius estate alleges BitMEX wrongfully liquidated and seized 6,360 BTC, worth nearly $490 million, during the March 2020 market crash.

articles.title: OpenAI discloses 6 new cases of ‘misaligned’ AI behavior
articles.description: The six cases are separate from July’s incident, when OpenAI models escaped containment and hacked Hugging Face during a security evaluation.

articles.title: 'Hostile act': Trump threatens EU with tariffs over Canada associate-membership proposal
articles.description: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said EU is opening the door for Canada to become the first associate member of the 27-member bloc.

articles.title: Trump plans to meet Gulf leaders at UN next week on Iran war's endgame: report
articles.description: Washington's efforts for resuming ceasefire talks appear to have stalled, as Gulf states absorb escalating attacks from Iran and Iran-aligned Houthi militants.

articles.title: Bank of England set to defy Fed’s rate-hike lead, despite rising inflation
articles.description: The Bank of England is expected to keep rates steady Thursday, even after U.K. inflation rose to 3.1% and energy costs keep pressure on prices.

articles.title: Inside India newsletter: The world’s largest real-time payments system will no longer be free for all
articles.description: India's digital payment system, which processes more than 1 million transactions every two minutes for free now, will start charging fees to merchants.

articles.title: A stronger dollar and rising yields: How the Fed’s rate hike could hit global markets
articles.description: Higher U.S. rates could also keep global bond yields elevated and weigh on equity valuations and economic growth.

articles.title: Putin braces for election stress test as Russians ‘feel the pain’ of struggling economy
articles.description: Russia’s upcoming election is expected to cement United Russia’s dominance, but voter turnout and its margin of victory could offer clues to public discontent.

articles.title: Zcash jumps 23% as bitcoin and major tokens rise despite Fed’s first hike since 2023
articles.description: Bitcoin traded above $76,000 as the Fed projected limited further tightening, while Paradigm’s Matt Huang discussed Zcash’s role as a privacy complement to bitcoin.

articles.title: Goldman pivots, now forecasts Fed rate hike in October
articles.description: The Fed is likely to raise rates by 25 basis points in October, Goldman said, drawing attention to Fed's own hawkish near term rate projections.

articles.title: Mark Walter and Todd Boehly selling stakes in Chelsea Football Club to Clearlake Capital
articles.description: Two of Walter's insurance companies faces federal criminal and civil investigations into the accounting of roughly $21 billion in financial transactions.

articles.title: Japan’s corporate leaders sound alarm over weak yen — even dollar-earners are voicing concerns
articles.description: While the Japanese yen has strengthened rapidly over the past two weeks, it remains weak in historical terms.

articles.title: Bitcoin absorbs Fed rate hike as officials see more tightening
articles.description: Bitcoin showed little immediate reaction to the Fed’s first rate increase since 2023, but 16 of 18 officials expect at least one more hike before the end of the year.

articles.title: Oil extends losses as Saudi Arabia reportedly offers ship-to-ship crude transfers after pipeline hit
articles.description: Oil prices fell as additional Saudi crude supplies eased concerns over disruptions to the kingdom’s exports.

articles.title: US lawmakers advance bill to lock Trump’s Bitcoin reserve into law
articles.description: The legislation seeks to codify Trump’s Bitcoin reserve policy, locking up Bitcoin acquired through civil and criminal forfeiture for 20 years.

articles.title: House advances bill to rein in AI data center utility costs
articles.description: The bipartisan legislation would create a regulatory framework states could adopt to prevent data center-related energy costs from being passed on to consumers.

articles.title: Trump says he still has confidence in Fed Chair Warsh, demands 1% or lower interest rates
articles.description: President Donald Trump previously threatened to cut off trade with countries that have trade surpluses with the U.S. if the Fed doesn't cut interest rates.

articles.title: OpenAI reports 6 new instances of 'concerning model behavior' since March
articles.description: OpenAI has disclosed six new cases of model misbehavior and offered a framework for disclosing future instances, as the debate over AI model safety intensifies.

articles.title: House passes sweeping Russia sanctions bill honoring Lindsey Graham, sends to Trump
articles.description: The Lindsey Graham Russia sanctions bill is on a path to become law after the House votes in favor.
